notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-040-Q01_5 'WATCH FOR TURNING TRAFFIC NEXT ... km' (2025, page 5 of 6), fully dimensioned, 3300 x 1800. Red sign: red edge 30 + white border 30 (the sheet's 30 / 60), r 130, white legend on Class 400 retroreflective red. The '*' diamond is the sheet's 'insert appropriate warning sign option - refer page 6': the six crash-scene options of page 6 (1-4 side impact, 5 head on, 6 rear end) are generated as variants, each scene the sheet PDF's own vector artwork placed in the diamond as page 6 draws it; the inset diamond is 900 side (note 2), yellow edge 15 + black border 30, r 60 (the QLD W-series values at that size; not dimensioned on this sheet), and the sheet's dimensions run to its rounded tips. Distance '**' = 'insert appropriate distance' with no example: 2, 5 and 10 km generated (the owner: the variants that make sense, not every value). Chain 200 / 200E / 190 / 200E / 190 / 200E / 240 / 180E-155Em / 200 = 1800: cap tops 200, 590, 980, 1420. Diamond: left tip 100 from the left edge, centred vertically. WATCH FOR ends 220 from the right edge (the sheet's '220'), word gap 152 measured; TURNING / TRAFFIC centred on x 2226 and the NEXT line on x 2213, as drawn (not dimensioned); NEXT to the dashed numeral box 200, box 187 wide, box to km 127.
